meta.title: 별점 테러 / Review Bombing
meta.note: duration·aspect는 프롬프트 본문이 아니라 힉스필드 생성 파라미터로 설정. 별점 UI·자막·D-카운트는 전부 포스트 그래픽 — 생성 클립에는 어떤 텍스트도 넣지 않는다.

look.palette: institutional fluorescent + monitor blue vs cosmic black sphere with golden fissure; Kepler = space documentary

wb.seoul_sky: sodium street warmth below, deep blue night above, golden fissure glow

look.grammar: comedy played straight — documentary-solemn camera (symmetry, slow push-ins) that never winks; Inspector/sphere = always upper frame, tilt-up; dialogue CUs shallow DOF; 35mm grain; no on-screen text

screen_direction_lock.rule: EP01 전체 불변. 미소(AI)는 보이스 온리 + 포스트 UI.

shotlist.cam: solemn documentary slow push-in, then static hold for deletion
shotlist.audio: Inspector V.O., deepest cosmic bass: The noodles went soggy.

shotlist.cam: slow lateral drift along the table toward the video-call wall
shotlist.audio: Scholar on screen, gravely: The signal means time itself is circular. / Second scholar: Agreed — and its center is Beijing.

shotlist.cam: she stands into frame; push-in as the room turns to her
shotlist.audio: SeoJin: This isn't grammar — it's an arrangement of flavors.

shotlist.cam: push-in on GangCheol, then widen as everyone stands
shotlist.audio: GangCheol, standing: Connect the worldwide broadcast — this moment goes in the textbooks.
Miso, serene AI voice: 'It has been a long journey. I want something warm and crispy.'

shotlist.cam: static MCU, dead-air holds between lines
shotlist.audio: Miso: Postscript — 'Is there parking?' / GangCheol, flat: Kill the broadcast.

shotlist.cam: slow push on SeoJin listening, screen glow on her glasses
shotlist.audio: Miso: Civilizations lie, art exaggerates, mathematics copies itself — taste does not lie.

shotlist.cam: locked OTS pair GangCheol/SeoJin, deadpan rhythm
shotlist.audio: GangCheol: Can we shoot it down? / Miso: The guest uses asteroids as an umbrella — when bored.

shotlist.cam: he slowly sits; whip to her exasperation
shotlist.audio: Miso: Yesterday the guest took a supernova in his espresso. / GangCheol, sitting down slowly: ...That's actually kind of cool.

shotlist.cam: tilt-up from crowd-less street to the sphere splitting into a mouth fissure
shotlist.audio: Inspector, vast and calm: The inspection of Earth begins — seven days.

shotlist.size: MS GangCheol at projector → CUT TO BLACK
shotlist.cam: static as he opens the laptop, beat, hold for post D-count
shotlist.audio: Miso: The guest lowered the rating by zero point one. — GangCheol: We haven't even started?! — Miso: We believe it was the font.
